## QC checklist

- [ ] Every historical claim in this change has a source that was actually opened (URL or page citation).
- [ ] Echo-only content. No other brands or personal accounts.
- [ ] `python3 caption_check.py` was run on any new or edited post folder (and the Checks workflow is green).
- [ ] TikTok captions include `#fyp` plus 3–4 researched niche tags.
- [ ] YouTube titles are 100 characters or fewer; TikTok captions are 2,200 or fewer.
- [ ] No cotton-field imagery; no AI faces for real people; nothing is labeled 4K.
- [ ] AI-generated narration is disclosed where a platform requires it.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or large media files (MP4/WAV) are in the diff.
- [ ] `templates/qc-checklist.md` was worked if this PR marks a story ready or posted.
